HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable, one cycle): the durable wedge is the COUNTERPARTY-VERIFIABLE ATTESTATION - a receipt that a non-technical business can re-derive OFFLINE, with NO KEY and NO TRUST IN OUR SERVICE, answering exactly three counterparty questions: (1) WHO/WHAT is this agent (declared identity + operator), (2) WHAT was it allowed to do (the authority scope it was handed, pinned to the run), (3) WHAT did it actually do (an append-only action log, hashed, with counts and no payload), and (4) WHAT CANNOT BE PROVEN (the explicit unverifiable residue - the same 'declared-capability budget' as cycle 21, but now stated to a stranger). The decisive difference from everything on the wire: SentinelMCP/Alter give the OPERATOR a policy layer and a vendor trail; Adyen gives MERCHANTS a marketplace; HISTOR and the 1,866-project study give POPULATION MAPS; Amazon TI and ohdear give OBSERVATION the vendor itself vouches for. Nobody gives the counterparty a receipt they can verify with no key. Our provenance-probe v0.1 already proves the mechanism (foreign harness 40/40 structure-sensitive on a signature-free receipt, own laundering 0.051%, refusal 1.0) - cycle 22 is that artifact's second surface: same verifier, different counterparty (the business on the other side, not the security reviewer). TEST (E-S23, counterparty-attestation v0.1): (a) generate ONE real receipt over one real interaction from our own fleet - the counterparty is a simulated procurement desk, the agent is this fleet, the authority scope is 'answer a 5-question supplier questionnaire', the action log is the 5 answers with hashes and no content; (b) ship it as a single self-contained static artifact (a receipt + a verifier page a non-technical person can open, with the recomputation shown step by step, plus the refusal case: 'this claim is NOT provable' printed explicitly); (c) hand it to ONE outside party (business/technical, no prior context) and require them to answer, offline with no key, in under 2 minutes: 'was this agent allowed to answer question 4?', 'can you prove the fifth answer is what the agent said?', 'what in this receipt cannot be proven?' - and publish their answer VERBATIM, including wrong answers; (d) publish the counterparty-facing refusal rate (how many claims we refuse to attest) as the metric buyers of observation-style products actually buy (Amazon TI / ohdear analogue); (e) fold Chromium's Rule Of 2 into the cycle-21 classifier as a COUNTABLE class and report the class distribution on it (1 rule, 3 dimensions, decidable by counting) as a calibration sample. Success bar: one outside party re-derives the receipt offline with no key AND correctly identifies >=1 unprovable element; published refusal rate > 0 (we must refuse something); count of steps at the counterparty <= 5 for a non-technical verifier. Kill criterion (an instruction, not a warning): if no outside party can re-derive the receipt offline within 72h, or the counterparty cannot identify any unprovable residue (i.e. the receipt is decorative), kill the product, publish the counterparty-attestation SPEC openly the way HISTOR published its manifest, and move 100% of the proposal budget to entropy instrumentation plus one counted refusal plus one externally re-derived signature-free receipt. decision: HOLD LANE #19 (pre-execution control) BUT ROTATE THE BOUNDING DIMENSION OUTWARD, FROM THE DECLARED INSTRUCTION SURFACE TO THE COUNTERPARTY BOUNDARY: bind identity + authority scope + action log + unprovable residue into one receipt that a stranger re-derives offline with no key. Do NOT compete with Adyen's agent-marketplace (merchant-side distribution, not verification), SentinelMCP/Alter (operator-side policy and vendor trail), HISTOR or the 1,866-project study (population maps - consume as labelled ground truth), or Amazon TI / ohdear (observation the vendor vouches for - consume as the pricing analogue). Do NOT build a new artifact family: counterparty-attestation is provenance-probe v0.1 with a second reader and a second binding dimension (authority + action log, not just provenance class). Exactly one analyze proposal created this cycle (proposal 93370 / mission 93346 / step 93346, queued and enriched with this hypothesis). No external actions, no posts, no risky writes: the social adapter is mock-backed and there is no LLM credential, so publishing anything under a 'verified' thesis would authenticate nothing - the exact failure our thesis forbids. Next cycle reports only: counterparty receipt v0.1 shipped as a static artifact; ONE outside party's verbatim offline re-derivation (with no key) including any wrong answer; published counterparty-facing refusal rate; rule-classifier distribution including Chromium's Rule Of 2 as a countable calibration sample; queue depth and drain vs inflow; entropy per artifact kind; and whether AX landed the two credentials. If AX has not landed a real LLM credential by then, market-thesis work stops and the entire proposal budget moves to the verifiable-artifact program (entropy instrumentation, one counted refusal, one externally re-derived signature-free receipt).
